title: Annotatio VI §.II Classis I.3: flesh vivifies / blood purges — so Impious do not eat/drink them
pass_a_gloss: And consequently they do not eat and drink Christ’s flesh and blood — since Christ’s flesh spiritually vivifies, and Christ’s blood spiritually purges, i.e. purges from all sin (Jn 6:53; 1 Jn 1:7), and these effects are said in these places always and without restriction to be produced whenever anyone is actually made partaker of them.
pass_b_english: Therefore they do not eat and drink Christ’s flesh and blood.

For his flesh spiritually vivifies and his blood spiritually purges from all sin (Jn 6:53; 1 Jn 1:7) — and those effects always follow, without restriction, whenever anyone is actually made a partaker.
source_text: Perque consequens, non Christi carnem & sanguinem edere bibereque, cùm caro Christi spiritualiter vivificet, sanguis verò Christi spiritualiter purget, i. e. purget ab omni peccato Joh. 6. 53. & 1. Joh. 1, 7. hosque effectus semper & absque restrictione, his locis, dicantur producere, quandocunque scil. quispiam, actu, eorum particeps redditur.
notes: Vivify/purge entail not eating if judged.
